name: raft
algorithm: Simulate a Raft cluster under std.sim for each seed of a range, with partitions and 5 percent message loss, check every run's history for linearizability and replay it, then print the summary and the history digest: the raft dogfood's bench case over more seeds (README.md).
notes: Tier A (M9 item 11.32): an Mk-only row, the raft dogfood unchanged, compared across mk binaries; no twin (std.sim has no peer), no defect line (README.md).
The quick arguments are the dogfood's own bench case (Dogfoods/raft/cases/bench.args).
The size (the seed range) is provisional; tools/bench verify -publish-size fixes it in the quiet window, and the checksum changes with it.
